description: CredibleMeds QTDrugs international reference list for drug-induced QT prolongation and Torsades de Pointes (TdP) risk stratification.
source: CredibleMeds / AZCERT (Arizona Center for Education and Research on Therapeutics)

known_risk.description: Drugs that prolong the QT interval and are clearly associated with a known risk of TdP, even when taken as recommended.

possible_risk.description: Drugs that can cause QT prolongation but currently lack substantial evidence of causing TdP when taken alone as recommended.

conditional_risk.description: Drugs associated with TdP but only under certain conditions (e.g., excessive dose, hypokalemia, or when co-administered with a drug that inhibits its clearance).
